body: C51 landed at 173/8. All eight were one rule: book_fight refused the bout agreement on any unknown-provenance hold, and unknown is nearly every hold (U12 leaves UFC as the only sourced regulator_kind, and your migration stamps old holds unknown). That repealed the 2026-09-01 commission model; the user reaffirmed it on 2026-09-08. R72 (27a075d) adds Sanctioning.medical_hold_refuses_booking() - refuses only a sourced commission-to-reciprocal-commission pair. medical_hold_binds() is UNTOUCHED, so fight-day still binds on unknown and enforce_pre_fight_medicals still cancels and voids. I changed one assertion in booking_eligibility_visibility_test (unknown now signs contingent, plus a fight-day proof and a new commission-vs-commission refusal case) and made body_readiness_integration_test read BodyReadiness.CURRENT_VERSION instead of the literal 2. Suite 181/0. Please pull before your next task.
